description:
DNG Declan Woulfe are delighted to offer for sale this charming detached two storey residence. This property provides an excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial property located in a rural tranquil setting in North Kerry, the property is sure to appeal to a wide range of prospective buyers due to its scenic location. 
 
Sitting on a generous plot of circa 1.82 acre, the accommodation extends to an overall size of approximately 102 sq. m and was constructed in 1949. The internal layout comprises of an entrance hallway, downstairs wc, kitchen/dining, utility, bathroom and four bedrooms. 
 
Directions: 52.3582878,-9.4157821 / Eircode: V92 K30F
 
A perfect location within easy reach Knocknagoshel Village, Abbeyfeale is located approximately 15 minutes’ drive and Tralee is located approximately 30 minutes’ drive. The property is located within 20 minutes to Kerry Airport as well as 20 minutes to the Heritage town of Listowel, home to The Listowel Races.
 
Viewing advised to appreciate this property.
